cases.name: original29
argv: import os,sys,json; from pathlib import Path; from tools.quantized_optimizers.score_dense import read_checkpoint_file; p=list(Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob("iter_000015/model.pt")); assert len(p)==1; pin=read_checkpoint_file(p[0]); Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(pin,indent=2)); os.execvp(sys.argv[3],sys.argv[3:]+["--checkpoint",str(p[0].parent),"--checkpoint-sha256",pin["sha256"]])
